items.title: NRG Energy (NRG) Stock Still Looks Like A Bargain On Its 171% Run
items.summary: NRG Energy is coming off a sharp pullback after a very strong multiyear run. This puts fresh focus on what investors are really paying for its earnings today. With the share price now around US$83, the key issue is how that level lines up with the profits the business is generating. Over the past 5 years, NRG Energy has delivered a total return of about 170.6%. This makes the current earnings valuation especially important for anyone considering fresh capital at today’s price.
